articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (NASDAQ: BTBT), today announced that its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (“AGM”) will be held on July 29, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time and that it has filed its Definitive Proxy Statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
